description: For each gridpoint in the range, in each of the specified degrees-of-freedom, checks if the gridpoint is fixed in that direction and, if so, creates an applied force equal to the current reaction force before freeing it.
notes: The manual lists force-reaction, force-reaction-x, force-reaction-y and force-reaction-z keywords; FLAC 9.8 (2D and 3D) rejects all four ('Unused extra parameter'). The command takes only a range.
